intended_user: Licensed dentist or authorized dental prescriber
intended_use: Surface source-backed medication teaching and safety considerations for a clinician-entered diagnosis after patient context is reviewed.
required_shared_context: allergies reviewed and structured allergy list
current medications reviewed and structured medication list
candidate_specific_context: Only collect renal, hepatic, pregnancy/lactation, weight, comorbidity, procedure, and other dose-relevant facts when an approved rule requires them; missing required facts block that candidate.
forbidden_actions: dose calculation not explicitly approved and validated
patient-directed advice to start, stop, or change a medicine
activation_gates: A practicing dentist reviews and signs off on the specialty workflow and every medication entry.
A pharmacist or qualified medication-safety reviewer checks allergy, interaction, contraindication and dose-related rules.
The source jurisdiction, current official labels/guidelines and update rights are verified.
Clinical evaluation cases cover contraindications, under-specified cases, children, pregnancy/lactation and interaction conflicts.
Regulatory, privacy, security and production operational review is approved.
